scope: Read-only independent review of upper/lower mesh descriptors, exported GLBs, integration code, and local Gray42 source figures. No checkout edits.

verified.transform: Exported Float32 coordinates match source OBJ vertices under x=rawX*s+tx, y=rawZ*s+ty, z=-rawY*s+tz. Nodes add no independent translation, rotation or scaling.
verified.laterality: Every new upper source name identifies right anatomy and has a negative raw-X center; every new lower source identifies left anatomy and has a positive raw-X center. Rhomboid vertebral origins cross the midline slightly but scapular bodies remain on the correct right side.
verified.runtimeRegistration: Supplement loads into the core scene before shared normalization; the attachment function does not independently normalize new meshes.

upper.carpal-bones: All eight carpals, reusing existing pisiform plus seven new named bones.
upper.adductor-pollicis-muscle: New oblique head plus existing transverse head.
upper.extensor-carpi-radialis-muscles: Existing longus and brevis named component meshes.

lower.quadriceps-femoris: Rectus femoris and all three vasti, including new vastus intermedius.
lower.toe-phalanges: Fourteen phalanges, with no middle phalanx for the hallux.

verified.incompleteGroupHandling: Intrinsic-foot-muscles is explicitly partial and preserveResidual=true in lower descriptors. Export generator only includes groups whose coverage starts with complete. It therefore does not delete the legacy intrinsic-foot residual.
sourceFigureChecks: Gray42 PDF1472 and PDF1476: carpal relations and named carpal bones.
Gray42 PDF1400: rhomboids and shoulder-girdle musculature.
Gray42 PDF1403 and PDF1412: arm muscle heads and related anatomy.
Gray42 PDF2169 and PDF2170: obturator externus, posterior thigh and gluteal musculature.
Gray42 PDF2193: gastrocnemius heads and popliteal boundaries.
Gray42 PDF2266, PDF2268 and PDF2269: lumbricals, plantar interossei, adductor hallucis and flexor hallucis brevis.

importantLimitations: The 53 structures are verified source-derived surfaces, not a claim of clinical segmentation accuracy or complete anatomy.

Upper lane correctly leaves latissimus dorsi, palmaris brevis and the deep head of flexor pollicis brevis without a new independent model. The rejected mirrored whole FPB is not reused as its deep head.
Lower lane lacks independently verified extensor digitorum brevis and all four dorsal foot interossei; retaining an existing intrinsic-foot aggregate is not proof those components are present.
A source muscle mesh may contain its tendon portion, but that does not make the tendon a separately selectable validated structure.

Existing capsular, ligament, meniscal, neural and surface-landmark layers remain schematic where explicitly marked. Real-mesh counts are selectable source-derived targets, including group aliases, rather than a count of unique independently segmented anatomical organs.

This review establishes source identity, laterality and numerical registration. Final rendered visibility, occlusion, camera framing, selection highlighting and desktop scrolling still require browser verification.
nonBlockingRecommendations: Expose the remaining source gaps in the user-facing study coverage and pair them with labeled 2D source figures.
Keep schematic labels visible for procedural geometry and avoid describing the overall atlas as completely modeled.
During browser QA, isolate a named carpal, gastrocnemius head, toe phalanx and intrinsic-foot component to verify the shared group aliases behave as intended.
